title: feat(plugin-detail): record:path stage press moves the record when allowStageChange is set
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoApKXpwrRwrv5gg6ftdt8KE)_

Fixes #28199
Refs #28061

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`record:path` 设了 `allowStageChange: true` 后，有权编辑状态字段的用户可以点击阶段（当前阶段除外），确认后把记录移到该阶段；没设这个键或无编辑权的用户，看到的仍是原来的只读进度条。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 销售测试反馈要能在路径上直接推进阶段（#27355 第 1 行）；spec 已在 #28198 声明了这个键，但控制台一直没读它，作者写了也没效果。
- 风险与回滚：只在作者显式开启时生效；写入走记录详情行内编辑同一条更新路径并带 `ifMatch` 并发令牌，合法与否由服务端状态机/校验/权限判定，前端不做第二套判定。回滚即 revert 本 PR，未开启的页面零影响。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`（谁能点、写入、拒绝文案）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`（阶段按钮与就地拒绝区）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`（注册表新增输入）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.stageChange-28199.test.tsx`，预期 14 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`record:path` honours `allowStageChange`.** With `allowStageChange: true`, each stage other than the current one carries a real `button` (accessible name "Move to STAGE") inside its existing `listitem`, on both the desktop and the phone row. A press opens a confirmation (`AlertDialog`); confirming writes `{ [statusField]: value }` and re-reads the record. Without the key, or with `false`, the DOM is the readout it was.
- **Who can press** (`useStageChange`, new `renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`): the record is stored and its data source can update; the record page's edit session allows editing the record (`useInlineEdit().canEdit`, the page host's record-level verdict); the status field is not read-only, computed or a system field; the caller's `recordEdit` field grant holds (`resolveFieldAffordance`). `RecordPathRenderer` now mounts `RecordFieldAccessForRecord` around the body when the key is on, so that grant is asked of this stored row, as `record:details` and `record:highlights` ask it. While the edit session holds an inline draft, the path is a readout again.
- **One update path.** The write goes through `updateVia` (now exported from `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`, not from the package index), the function the inline-edit save bar uses, with the record's `updated_at` as `ifMatch`.
- **Refusals in place** (`stageRefusalLines`), under the rails, once for both rows: a `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` 409 gets a fixed line and the record is re-read; a producer-marked `userMessage` verbatim; a field-scoped refusal (`VALIDATION_FAILED` `fields[]`, the shape an illegal `state_machine` transition and a missing required field arrive in) one line per entry, an entry about another field prefixed with its label; a permission refusal the delegated-scope reason or a fixed line; anything else the server message or a fixed line. The next press clears it.
- **Published.** `allowStageChange` joins the block's registry `inputs` (boolean, renderer-accurate description), so `sdui.manifest.json`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and the generated component reference (`content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx`, `index.mdx`) are regenerated, and the `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry `record:path.allowStageChange` is deleted from `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`.
- **Copy.** Seven `detail.pathStageChange*` keys in all ten packs and in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/28199-record-path-stage-change.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Why

The spec half (#28198) declared `RecordPathProps.allowStageChange`, and the console registry carried it as unpublished because nothing read it. Authors who set it got the read-only rail. This is the console half that #28061 names.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.stageChange-28199.test.tsx`, 14 cases:

- the press writes: buttons on every non-current stage in both rows; confirm calls `update('crm_quote', 'q1', { status: 'in_review' }, { ifMatch: VERSION })` and `refresh`; cancel writes nothing;
- a refusal renders in place: an illegal `state_machine` transition (the server sentence alone), a required field elsewhere (label-prefixed), a 403 (fixed line, not the raw text), a stale token (fixed line plus a re-read), and the next press clears it;
- the readout stays: the key absent (control, for a reader who could edit), `false`, the page's edit session refusing the record, the field edit grant denied, a read-only status field, an inline draft in progress.

Ablations (one-shot, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proved the mutation landed and restored `git diff HEAD` empty; the subject resolves to source through the vitest alias, so no rebuild applies):

| Mutation in `recordPathStageChange.tsx` | Red |
| :--- | :--- |
| `ifMatch` token dropped from the update | the write case (1 of 14) |
| `allowStageChange` removed from the verdict | both opt-in controls (2 of 14) |
| `!inline.editing` removed | the inline-draft case (1 of 14) |
| `resolveFieldAffordance(...)` removed | the field-grant case (1 of 14) |
| `setRefusal(...)` removed | all five refusal cases (5 of 14) |

## Acceptance notes

- **"Reachable" means "drawn and not current."** The path does not read the object's `state_machine` transitions to hide stages: that would be a second evaluator of a rule the server owns. Every drawn stage the record is not on is pressable, and an illegal move comes back as the server's refusal, shown in place. Stages a record's own columns rule out (option `visibleWhen`) are already not drawn.
- **Inline draft.** While the record's inline edit holds a draft the stages are not pressable, so a stage write never races the draft's Save. Said here because the card did not ask for it.
- **Concurrency.** A 409 is not routed to `ConcurrentUpdateDialog`'s overwrite: a stage move is one field, and the re-read record plus a second press is the whole recovery.
- **File surface.** Beyond the claim's surface, the diff carries the generated half of a registry change that root `AGENTS.md` requires ("A registry change has a second half"): `sdui.manifest.json`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, and the generated reference pages `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx` and `index.mdx` (`node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`, gated by `check:sdui-reference`). No hand edit in any of them.
- **Clause-②: yes**, measured from the diff: the block's published `inputs` gain a key (the manifest and the component reference grow by one input). The claim recorded `no` as the seat's expectation; the dispatch order says publishing the input counts.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (package README and docs): the docs page for this input is the generated component reference (`content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx`), regenerated here. `plugin-detail`'s README covers `record:details` / `record:highlights` / `record:quick_actions` / `record:related_list` binding and says nothing about `record:path` today; it is outside the claimed surface and left untouched — the seat may want a README line.
